tasks.label: start-app
args: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:4098 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then kill $pids; sleep 1; fi; cd control-plane/app && UI_DEV_SERVER_URL=${UI_DEV_SERVER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:5173} exec bun run dev

tasks.label: start-web-ui
args: pids=(${(f)"$(lsof -ti tcp:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true)"}); if (( ${#pids[@]} )); then kill "${pids[@]}"; fi; fallback=(${(f)"$(lsof -ti tcp:5174 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true)"}); if (( ${#fallback[@]} )); then kill "${fallback[@]}"; fi; sleep 1; cd control-plane/web-ui && VITE_APP_PORT=${VITE_APP_PORT:-${APP_PORT:-4098}} exec bun run dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173

tasks.label: debug-session-message-500
args: const CP_URL=process.env.TEST_CP_URL||"http://127.0.0.1:4097"; const USERNAME=process.env.TEST_USERNAME||"admin"; const PASSWORD=process.env.TEST_PASSWORD||"admin123!"; const loginRes=await fetch(`${CP_URL}/api/auth/login`,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({username:USERNAME,password:PASSWORD})}); const login=await loginRes.json(); const token=login.token; const taskRes=await fetch(`${CP_URL}/api/tasks`,{method:"POST",headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({projectId:process.env.TEST_PROJECT_ID||"proj-default",title:`debug-${Date.now()}`,prompt:"debug prompt"})}); const task=await taskRes.json(); console.log("task",taskRes.status,JSON.stringify(task)); const runtimeSessionId=`debug-session-${Date.now()}`; const sessionRes=await fetch(`${CP_URL}/api/tasks/${task.id}/sessions`,{method:"POST",headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({runtimeSessionId,branchName:"debug-branch",sourceType:"root",isActive:true})}); console.log("session",sessionRes.status,await sessionRes.text()); const msgRes=await fetch(`${CP_URL}/api/tasks/${task.id}/sessions/messages`,{method:"POST",headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({runtimeSessionId,message:{info:{id:`msg-${Date.now()}`,role:"assistant"},parts:[{type:"text",text:"hello"}]}})}); console.log("message",msgRes.status,await msgRes.text());
